welcome: [1mpi-brand[0m names your product inside pi: the model proposes names, you pick favorites, and it checks whether your finalists are taken.
This is real pi with the extension. The model, the web search and the domain lookups are scripted samples, so it needs no key.
pi opens by itself in an app that still needs a name. Press the first button above, then:
Space            pick a name as a favorite
Enter            save them and open the overview
Check finalists  in the overview: choose up to three, then Deep check
/brand           the second button opens the overview again
Change the theme at the top right and pi follows it.
hints: /brand a reminder app that tells you when to water each plant
